name: Damemon
main_effect:
[On Play] By placing 1 [Bagra Army] trait Digimon card from your hand or trash under any of your Tamers, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [Tuwarmon] with a play cost of 7 or less from under your Tamers without paying the cost. Then, ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
source_effect: When effects trash this card from a [Bagra Army] trait Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
